digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: Agent-driven development loop lacks aggregation layer and durable metrics tracking; available signals (event-sourced ticket history, gate sidecars, module-size ratchet, git) are never persisted or queried for trends

Three Tier-C blindspots leave no durable trace in event store: (a) env/integration-diagnosis intervals, (b) bug provenance/which prior change caused a bug, (c) bug outcome classification (regression vs plan-defect vs flaky)

Rebar metrics command must emit all registered metrics across three lenses (agent loop health, codebase decay, gate economics) for a configurable date range, with unavailable metrics reporting structured reason and accrual timestamp

Blamed caused_by derivation runs post-commit after bug close, bypassing closed-source guards by writing directly via _write_link_event; best-effort auto-derivation blames pre-fix parent commit and skips when file_impact is ambiguous or unresolvable

Bug close replaces required free-text --reason with bounded --class enum persisted on STATUS event; required-argument count for bug close remains exactly 1 (swap, not addition); historical bugs backfilled with classified confidence

Snapshot series committed to git-tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson; backfilled metrics labeled source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified never aggregated into authoritative structural series; is_authoritative() returns False for backfill sources
